scope: Headless Chromium (Playwright chromium-1194) with ANGLE SwiftShader, a CPU rasterizer, in a Linux container without a GPU. 1280 x 900, DPR 1, daylight, reduced motion, full HDR pipeline (4x MSAA half-float target, bloom, composite). Each sample is one complete synchronous frame: render, then a 1-pixel readback of the canvas, which waits for every pass. Relative checks only; texture filtering runs in software here, and GPU cost was not measured.

pairedMaterialSwap.method: One page. The old (merged) coat materials are rebuilt from their source next to the new ones and swapped onto the same meshes; variants alternate in ABCD/DCBA order, 3 frames per visit, 4 rounds per view (12 samples each). Compilation happens before timing.

variants.old: Merged coat: physical material with sheen, three procedural noises on the skin
variants.noTexture: This pass with the two noise-volume reads replaced by a constant (isolates their cost)
variants.physicalBrdf: This pass with the old physical BRDF instead of the fur lobes (isolates the lighting)

againstOriginalCoat.method: Separate browser launches, ABBA order, 4 rounds, 7 frames each (median of medians). v0 is main at 9a087ee, before both fur passes: 324,967 triangles, 4,844,876-byte model. new is this pass on the 229,227-triangle model. "character" hides the plinth, atmosphere and soot sprites.

noiseCheck.method: The same build measured against itself in separate launches, 2 rounds.
